handback.title: Installing adds only the workflow and settings
handback.summary: Installing Dokima puts one short workflow and one settings file in a repo, and nothing else.
handback.user_story: Installing Dokima adds one short workflow and a settings file to a repo, and no Dokima code.

acceptance_criteria.text: When Dokima is installed, the repo gains exactly two files: its one workflow and its settings file.

edge_cases.case: An empty repo with no commits yet gets the same two files.

acceptance_criteria.text: When Dokima is installed, no file it adds holds any secret's value.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: The install takes no input from the owner; the test sets every secret Dokima reads.

acceptance_criteria.text: When Dokima is installed, its settings file carries no owner's co-author line from Dokima's own repo.
acceptance_criteria.words: Never ship my line as a default
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: One fixed settings file is installed; there is no other case.

test_changes.tests/test_playthrough.py::test_the_play: Owner asked install add only workflow and settings; still installs the played commit.

raises.label: Old copy stays
raises.text: The sandbox already holds the old copied Dokima code and workflows; a new install leaves them there, still running.
raises.evidence: `dokima/playthrough.py` `Sandbox.install` writes into a clone of the sandbox and never removes files.
